Container.Name: bitcoin-paper-bot-v3
Container.Overview: Bitcoin AI paper-bot v3: connects to your existing Ollama server. Configure enable, URL, model and optional API key directly in the dashboard. No separate AI container or admin page. 500 simulated DKK.

Config.Name: Konfiguration
Config.Description: V3 config.json; AI-baseadresse og model står her. Ændret konfiguration kræver ny session.

Config.Name: Handelsdata
Config.Description: Egen saldo, handelslog og AI-historik. Må ikke deles med andre bots.

Config.Name: Enable AI initially
Config.Description: Saved dashboard preferences take priority after first save.

Config.Name: Ollama server URL
Config.Description: Use server LAN IP:port or Docker name on a shared custom network.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Model already installed in your Ollama container.

Config.Name: API key (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank for standard local Ollama; may be used for an authenticated proxy.
